author: claude
body: Today Share, Same roots and the commentary each open their own sheet, and the verse drawer steps aside until that sheet closes. I've logged your idea as open question ③ in `docs/decisions/selection-drawer.md` and on the backlog: the drawer grows to hold the tool's contents (as a section, or as tabs), tried beside today's sheets in a rough build. The drawer must still never cover the verse it is about, so the build has to find how tall it can grow. I'm leaving this thread open until it's built. (The picture saved with this comment came out blank, so I worked from your words.)
